title: Decode UTF-8 JSON Buffers with a leading BOM.
criteria:
## Problem

The JSON decoder accepts a string with one leading Unicode BOM, but throws
when the same JSON arrives as a UTF-8 Node.js Buffer.

## Task

Update `Json.decode` in `lib/paypalhttp/serializer/json.js` to decode UTF-8
Buffers using the same single-leading-BOM handling already used for strings.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Decode valid UTF-8 Buffers with no BOM or exactly one leading U+FEFF.
   Cover objects containing Unicode, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans and null.
2. Preserve U+FEFF characters inside JSON string values.
3. Empty input, malformed JSON, invalid prefixes, BOM-only input and two
   leading BOM characters must still throw `SyntaxError`.
4. Do not mutate input Buffers. Preserve existing string decoding, encode and
   contentType behavior. General Uint8Array support is outside this task.
5. Keep all existing tests. Add regression tests in
   `demo-test/serializers.test.cjs` and pass
   `node --test demo-test/serializers.test.cjs`.
   Change only the JSON serializer and that test file.

## Demo scope

Proposed reward: $50 USD PayPal sandbox in this isolated demo repository.
Funding and payout remain subject to verified capture and the funded terms.
